data.title: 双叶理央 · 物理实验室的白色誓约
data.description: 【物理实验室改造礼堂·午后】理央穿着带银灰腰带的简洁婚纱坐在实验台旁，黑框眼镜与头纱被她分开放好；她用小量筒做花瓶，把蓝色小花插入其中，抬眼时理性神情被温柔取代。
data.location: science lab converted into a quiet ceremony room
data.action: 实验台旁用量筒插花，精准调整花枝后露出意外温柔的笑
data.lighting: cool daylight mixed with warm task lamps
data.promptProse: Rio Futaba from Rascal Does Not Dream of Bunny Girl Senpai wears a clean white bridal dress with a silver-grey sash, simple veil, black-rimmed glasses and a tiny blue-flower beaker. She sits at the lab table using a graduated beaker as a tiny vase, her glasses resting beside the veil. She adjusts the blue flowers with scientific precision, then looks toward the viewer as the cool room light meets a surprisingly tender smile. cool daylight mixed with warm task lamps.
